# Certificate distribution UI

Certificates and linked assets show distribution status for the selected managed certificate. The certificate's Deployments view shows published versions, assigned consumers, verification and Jobs links. It distinguishes publication, installation, service use and trust; discovery alone is not proof of consumption.

Use **Manage distribution** to configure consumers, request or review rollouts, manage maintenance and monitoring, run preflight, inspect incidents and preview retention. Changes that need approval are reviewed in Jobs. Workspace permissions and the selected workspace apply throughout. See the [distribution guide](../../../docs/certops/distribution-lifecycle.md).
